````{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("here")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("gganimate")
install.packages("terra")
install.packages("tidyterra")
install.packages("rnaturalearth")
install.packages("rnaturalearthdata")
install.packages("gifski")
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(gifski)
````

````{r}

godwit <- read_csv(here("data", "GODWIT_dataset_geocoded.csv"))

````



````{r}
#create year column
godwit <- godwit %>%
  mutate(
    year = str_extract(Date_of_Accusation, "\\d{4}") %>% as.integer()
  )

````


````{r}
#remove NULL values
map_data <- godwit %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude), !is.na(year)) %>%
  arrange(year)
````


````{r}

suspect_years <- godwit %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), (year < 1300 | year > 1820)) %>%
  select(Date_of_Accusation, year)
 
if (nrow(suspect_years) > 0) {
  message("Found ", nrow(suspect_years), " row(s) with an implausible year — check these in the source CSV:")
  print(suspect_years)
}

````




````{r}

countries_sf <- ne_countries(scale = "medium",
                              country = c("Denmark", "Sweden", "Germany"),
                              returnclass = "sf")

````


````{r}
bbox <- c(xmin = 6.5, xmax = 16.5, ymin = 53.8, ymax = 58.8)

countries_v <- vect(countries_sf) %>%
  crop(ext(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"], bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"]))

````


````{r}
stretch <- 5  

map_data <- map_data %>%
  mutate(
    time_index = case_when(
      year <  1500                 ~ year - 1500,
      year >= 1500 & year <= 1700  ~ (year - 1500) * stretch,
      year >  1700                 ~ (1700 - 1500) * stretch + (year - 1700)
    )
  )


cat("Total rows in CSV:              ", nrow(godwit), "\n")
cat("Rows missing lat/lon:           ", sum(is.na(godwit$latitude) | is.na(godwit$longitude)), "\n")
cat("Rows where no year was found:   ", sum(is.na(godwit$year)), "\n")
cat("Rows with an implausible year:  ", nrow(suspect_years), "\n")
cat("Rows actually plotted:          ", nrow(map_data), "\n")
cat("Coverage:                       ", round(100 * nrow(map_data) / nrow(godwit), 1), "%\n")
````

````{r}
#create static map
static_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatvector(data = countries_v, fill = "#f2ede4", color = "#8c8c8c", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(
    data = map_data,
    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = geo_precision),
    alpha = 0.75, size = 2
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]), ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"])) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(original = "#7a1f1f", town = "#c0392b", herred = "#e08283", region = "#e6b8b8"),
    name = "Location precision"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Witchcraft accusations in Denmark",
    subtitle = "All recorded cases",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
  size = 24,
  color = "#7a1f1f",
  face = "bold"
),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(static_map)


````


````{r}
#animated map

anim_map <- static_map +
  labs(
  subtitle = "Year: {round(ifelse(
    frame_time < 0,
    frame_time + 1500,
    ifelse(
      frame_time <= 1000,
      frame_time / 5 + 1500,
      frame_time + 700
    )
  ))}"
) +
  transition_time(time_index) +
  enter_fade() + enter_grow() +
  exit_fade() + exit_shrink() +
  shadow_wake(wake_length = 0.08, alpha = TRUE, size = TRUE) +
  ease_aes("cubic-in-out")

n_years <- diff(range(map_data$year))
 
animated <- gganimate::animate(
  anim_map,
  nframes = 500,
  fps = 15,
  width = 900, height = 900, res = 150,
  end_pause = 20,
 renderer = gganimate::gifski_renderer(loop = TRUE)
)

print(animated)

````



````{r}

anim_save(here("data", "godwit_accusations_animated.gif"), animation = animated)


````
